design: Choose the first fully supported pooled-local versus legacy-veto reversal with a disjoint loss beyond the frozen tolerance, by entry start and ascending band. For the matched-fit rule, use exactly the pooled rule's first two early count blocks as the local fit for both validation trials. Validate separately on the third and fourth early blocks, then apply the identical tolerance logic. Freeze all choices before pairing any late block. Score both veto rules and the pooled baseline on the selected window. All local forecasts pool all four early blocks.
boundary: One new acquisition on the same readout. Both matched-fit validation trials share their fit. Equal fit counts remove the shorter training-fit difference, while validation counts can still differ and the revised trials occur later in the early period. The replay cannot isolate temporal drift from finite validation-count variation.
